CustomField.description: How Backup Sets and archives send their CSV files through this connection (canonical model R-CN11): method (PUT or POST), a path with the {file} slot and up to five fixed headers that hold no secret. Blank when the connection is not the backup destination; at most one row has it. Written and read by the module only, in system mode; never a key.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How backup files are sent through this connection. Set on the Connections section of Super Connector.
CustomField.label: Backup Settings
